description: Clootrack's Genie lets you explore your customer-experience data in plain language inside ChatGPT. Ask about sentiment, themes, brand and product feedback, and complaints across your reviews, support tickets, surveys and social data and get answers grounded in your own sources, with verbatim customer quotes (citations) on request. Built for CX, product and marketing teams who need decision-ready insight from large volumes of unstructured feedback. No technical setup.
